visual_argument: One rigid sterilization container stands for one case at one scale: a wall of 339 steel locked ends with a person at its foot, then the same wall crowned by 25 gold locked ends, then the 25 lids in 41 taped bays for the interval, so the estimate reads as a thin gold crown and its range as empty bays a reader can count.
build_risk: 364 container ends in an instanced wall must stay separable at 432 px with seams, handles and locks, the gold must hold its hue under a cold key, and the wall must read as objects beside a person rather than a stacked bar. The cover's wall camera and surgical light heads are chassis models that must not read as a box on a stick or a flat disc.
distinct_from_recent: No. 54 was a lastLight exterior of brush country with a fly and windmills; this is an interior deck in floodlit with no sky. No. 53 was nine darkfield reliefs of a tissue section with type in a fixed top band; here four reliefs sit among five room renders and the type moves. No. 52 was nightSodium with one robotaxi hero on every frame; here the unit is a sterile container that changes state, and there is no vehicle.
